sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Casterwill's younger son fought alongside hisfamily in the great war against the Nullifiers. [Knight of the Willblade]

He and his siblings were teleported by Umbra to the Spiral Mark, where he watched Lord Casterwill seal the Mark using the Willblade. [The Spiral Mark]

Some time after the death of Lord Casterwill, on the longest night of the year, he and his siblings fought the Betrayer at the Spiral Mark, stopping him from using Void to call back the Nullifiers. [Chasing Void]

He eventually laid the Ring of Mythras to rest in the Fortress of Iron Will where the Rue Guardians created the Trial of Courage as means of gaining leadership of the family. The ring was eventually recovered by Sophie Casterwill who gave it to Vivian Casterwill. [Sophie on Trial] [The Spiral War]

full_text:
The younger son of Casterwill was one of Lord Casterwill's children and the previous Seeker bonded to Mythras, the Legendary Titan of Valour .

History

Casterwill's younger son fought alongside hisfamily in the great war against the Nullifiers. [Knight of the Willblade]

He and his siblings were teleported by Umbra to the Spiral Mark, where he watched Lord Casterwill seal the Mark using the Willblade. [The Spiral Mark]

Some time after the death of Lord Casterwill, on the longest night of the year, he and his siblings fought the Betrayer at the Spiral Mark, stopping him from using Void to call back the Nullifiers. [Chasing Void]

He eventually laid the Ring of Mythras to rest in the Fortress of Iron Will where the Rue Guardians created the Trial of Courage as means of gaining leadership of the family. The ring was eventually recovered by Sophie Casterwill who gave it to Vivian Casterwill. [Sophie on Trial] [The Spiral War]

Abilities

Not much in known on the younger son's abilities, but as he was bonded to Mythras, he would have had a courageous heart. He fought valiantly against the Betrayer and the Nullifiers.
